title: The Magic Backpack
description: A backpack that gives you what you need (but not what you want)

fields.prompt: What is a silly describing word?
What would you yell when surprised?
What is a verb ending in -ing?

template:
{name1} found a backpack at the back of the closet. It was old and {adj}, and it hummed a little. Pinned inside was a note that said: "Reach in and pull out what you need. WARNING: I do not always know what you need."

"Easy," said {name1}, and reached in, hoping for a snack. Out came one {object}.

"That is not a snack," said {name2}, who was watching. "Try again."

So {name1} reached in again and pulled out one very annoyed {animal}. "I was taking a nap," said the {animal}, and then it went right back to sleep on the rug.

The third time, out came a giant pile of {food}. It slid across the floor and covered {name2}'s shoes. "Okay, now we're getting somewhere," said {name2}.

But the backpack was just getting started. It went {noise}, and suddenly {plural} began raining from the ceiling! The backpack wiggled and tickled {name1}'s {bodyPart}, and the {animal} woke up and started {verbing} around the room.

"{exclaim}" yelled {name2}. "Make it stop!"

{name1} closed both eyes, reached in one last time, and pulled out a tiny note. It said: "Oh, you needed a break. Sorry. Thanks for visiting. See you tomorrow."

The backpack gave one last hum and went still.

{name1} and {name2} cleaned up the {food}, tucked in the {animal}, and put the backpack back in the closet.

The next morning it was gone. But strangely, {name2}'s closet was humming.
